verdict.rationale: Autonomous AI decisioning is a fair axis for a CDP, but the evidence shows no agent that picks messages, timing, or channels per customer within user-set guardrails, and no lift measurement. What is documented is related but different: predictive ML attributes appended to profiles, audience building and activation, and AI chat or MCP agents for managing pipelines. None of these is the decisioning capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI decisioning agents pick messages, timing, and channels per customer autonomously within guardrails I set, with measurable lift
